First of all, it was always about the oldschool maps. For example [[Duelmania 1]] and [[Duelmania 2]] had only TB3 (dm2, dm4, dm6). [[Duelmania 3]] was the first one that introduced [[TB5]] (adding [[ztndm3]] and [[aerowalk]]). And secondly, it never used a forgiving structure like group games or divisions. This way of doing duel tournaments has been absent in recent years, mainly because nowadays' tournaments like [[Hammer Time Season 1|Hammertime]] and [[Thunderdome]] are very rookie-friendly and very open to new maps.
